decisions.reason: As an established-adjacent plug-in product line with modular models and low carrying cost, it remains a valuable option to keep open while format demand continues to evolve.

The building data digital twin service still fits the firm's strategic direction, but after two years its higher delivery and market-development burden makes it a materially riskier option than the more incremental offers.

Because this identity-related service overlaps with the more GIS-specific identity and access offer, the uncertainty has likely resolved enough that consolidating resources is preferable to keeping both options open.
The GIS-focused identity and access service supports the firm's broader enterprise-integration strategy and is the stronger option to retain in this area after reviewing the overlapping portfolio.
This consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's training and advisory capabilities, so it is inexpensive to maintain and still too new to justify abandonment.
